note: Installation entry point. Ships empty on purpose: an unconfigured installation denies every target. The installation operator fills this in; nothing here is copied from the upstream project's operational accounts, services or targets. scripts/check-scaffold.mjs refuses to pass if a populated version is committed. Admission is decided here and nowhere else: a repository named in targets.repositories is admitted on that basis alone, and targets.fallback_owners names owners whose matching rules are read from targets.registry_url, so fallback owners require a registry while explicit repositories do not. Settings that describe an admitted target, such as its package manager, still come from the profile inventory. This file is read once per process; changing it takes a restart. Every field is required and undeclared fields are rejected, matching schema/lina-check-installation.schema.json exactly.
